business_summary: Skylark Holdings Co., Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company also engages in the provision of food services and related businesses; sale of food products; franchise operation of yakiniku buffet restaurants and family restaurants; café, office catering, food court business, etc.; and development of restaurants, etc. It operates various Japanese, Western, and Chinese cuisine restaurants primarily under the Gusto, Bamiyan, Jonathan's, Yumean, Steak Gusto, Grazie Gardens, Aiya, Musashino Mori Coffee, Karayoshi, Totoyamichi, chawan, Tonkaratei, La Ohana, GRAND BUFFET, Festa Garden, Tomato and Onion, Jyu-Jyu Karubi, FLO Prestige, Café Grazie, SYABU-YO, Skylark, YOKOHAMA Steakhouse, Miwami, Yumean Shokudo, Tohsai, Hachiro Soba, Granbu, THE BUFFET TENSHIN-TENSHIN, POU POU TENSHIN THE BUFFET, BUFFET Ex Blue, KUSHI-YO, PERTICA, Sukesan Udon, Buffet the Forest, The Buffet New Markets, and SHABU-YO brand names. The company also provides foodstuffs and concession stand products delivery, store cleaning and maintenance, and linen supply services. Skylark Holdings Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Skylark Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Skylark Holdings Co., Ltd. in July 2018. Skylark Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is based in Musashino, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Skylark Holdings Co., Ltd.는 일본 및 해외에서 레스토랑을 운영하고 있습니다. 회사는 또한 식품 서비스 및 관련 사업을 제공합니다. 식품 판매; 야키니쿠 뷔페 레스토랑 및 패밀리 레스토랑의 프랜차이즈 운영; 카페, 사무실 케이터링, 푸드코트 사업 등; Gusto, Bamiyan, Jonathan's, Yumean, Steak Gusto, Grazie Gardens, Aiya, Musashino Mori Coffee, Karayoshi, Totoyamichi, chawan, Tonkaratei, La Ohana, GRAND BUFFET, Festa Garden, Tomato and Onion, Jyu-Jyu Karubi, FLO Prestige, Café를 중심으로 다양한 일식, 양식, 중식 레스토랑을 운영하고 있습니다. Grazie, SYABU-YO, Skylark, YOKOHAMA Steakhouse, Miwami, Yumean Shokudo, Tohsai, Hachiro Soba, Granbu, THE BUFFET TENSHIN-TENSHIN, POU POU TENSHIN THE BUFFET, BUFFET Ex Blue, KUSHI-YO, PERTICA, Sukesan Udon, Buffet the Forest, The Buffet New Markets 및 SHABU-YO 브랜드 이름. 또한 이 회사는 식료품 및 매점 제품 배송, 매장 청소 및 유지 관리, 리넨 공급 서비스도 제공합니다. 스카이락홀딩스(주)는 기존 스카이락(주)에서 사명을 스카이락홀딩스(주)로 변경하였습니다.
